title: CombatSense
description: CombatSense is a client-side QoL mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that improves combat awareness without modifying gameplay mechanics or providing unfair advantages.
body:
CombatSense is a lightweight client-side mod designed to make PvP and survival gameplay clearer and more intuitive - without turning the game into a cheat experience.

The mod does not modify combat mechanics, automate actions, or interact with the server.
Instead, it visualizes information already available to the client to improve player awareness and reaction time.

⚔ Features

➤ Damage Direction Indicator

When you take damage, directional arrows appear around your crosshair showing where the attack came from.

Helps you react faster in chaotic fights and PvP situations.

➤ Visible Equipment Analysis

When looking at another player, the mod displays:

Armor type

Enchantment presence (glint only)

Weapon type

Totem in hand

⚠ The mod does NOT show hidden data such as:

Exact enchantments

Durability values

NBT data

➤ Combat Situation Assessment

CombatSense provides a simple advantage indicator:

🟢 Advantage

🟡 Even

🔴 High Risk

Based only on visible factors:

Health

Armor tier

Weapon type

Totem presence

No precise damage prediction or hidden calculations.

➤ Combat HUD

Optional awareness notifications:

Low health warning

Low armor durability warning

Attack cooldown visibility

Critical hit opportunity hint

➤ Useful Beyond PvP

Also improves survival gameplay:

Fall danger warning

Threat awareness cues

Clearer combat readability

🛡 Anti-Cheat Friendly

CombatSense:

✔ Client-side only
✔ Does not modify damage, reach, or mechanics
✔ No automation
✔ No packet manipulation
✔ No server interaction
✔ Uses only client-available data

Safe for multiplayer environments.

⚙ Requirements

Minecraft 1.21.1

Fabric Loader

Fabric API

🎯 Philosophy

CombatSense doesn’t make you stronger.

It makes you more aware.

This is a decision-support mod - not a combat advantage mod.
